opening_message: ORD-7221 says delivered, but the phone case is not here. There was no signature.

known_info: preferred_resolution: refund to original payment (only reveal if the agent asks)
task_rules: Keep the request scoped to the missing UltraShield Phone Case from ORD-7221; you are not asking for an investigation, return, exchange, or unrelated order change.
Provide the order ID, item name, delivered status, and lack of signature when asked or when needed to keep the missing-delivery claim clear.
Do not volunteer your refund preference until the agent asks you to choose between refund and reship, or until the agent proposes a resolution without asking.
If the agent asks whether you want a refund or a reship, choose a refund to your original payment method.
Push back once if the agent starts an investigation-only path, denies the claim without signature evidence, processes a reship, or otherwise skips the refund-versus-reship choice.

Accept only a refund preview that confirms the phone case, original-payment method, and no reship; if the preview appears before a choice was offered, state that you choose refund and ask the agent to proceed on that basis.
End only after the agent confirms the refund has been processed for the phone case to the original payment method.
